result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` and `DemoScenarioTest` pass (5 tests, 0 failures).

- **Fix:** `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 6518) now adds `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to its `WHERE` clause. This is the same filter the per-quarter, per-weekday and per-country purchase-order queries use.
- **Test:** I added `leavesOutCancelledPurchaseOrders` to `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest`. It creates a North sent order for Anna and a South sent order for Bob, plus two cancelled South orders, and expects `Anna:1, Bob:1`. To support it, I added a status-taking overload of the test helper `purchaseOrder`.

I did not run the new test against the unfixed query, so I haven't seen it fail before the fix. Nothing is committed.
